cookies.name: __Host-fcr_session
cookies.purpose: Carry a high-entropy opaque Founder Control Room browser-session capability whose authoritative credentials, expiry, rotation, revocation, founder identity, and continuity-integrity state remain server-side.
cookies.integrity: 256-bit server-issued random capability; only its SHA-256 lookup hash is persisted and the cookie grants no authority without active server-side session state whose deterministic continuity_fingerprint also validates.
cookies.csrf: Approved same-origin browser context is required for privileged mutations; founder authority remains separately gated by FCR policy.
cookies.deletion: Cleared by POST /auth/logout, session rotation failure, and failed or disallowed browser-session verification. Server-side logout also records revocation.

cookies.name: fcr_session
cookies.purpose: Legacy founder-session cookie name retained only as an explicit deletion target during migration to the __Host-fcr_session opaque capability.
cookies.integrity: Never accepted for authentication after opaque-session cutover; emitted only with Max-Age=0 to remove historical self-contained token cookies.
cookies.csrf: Not accepted as an authentication or authorization input.
cookies.deletion: Expired whenever a new opaque session is issued or any founder browser session is cleared.

cookies.name: fcr_friend_intake_review
cookies.purpose: Carry a short-lived, server-signed capability proving the interactive founder reviewed the exact sensitive Friend Intake save payload before persistence.
cookies.integrity: HMAC-SHA256 v2 capability with a fresh nonce, bound to founder identity, the originating opaque browser-session hash, exact raw input, redacted summary, persisted sensitive categories, persisted intent tags, persisted move kind/policy/duration/warning code, blocked model state, engine version, and five-minute expiry. Its token deterministically derives the sensitive intake/timeline UUID pair so database uniqueness enforces one-review/one-save consumption without storing the raw review token.
cookies.csrf: SameSite=Strict plus the interactive opaque founder-session boundary constrain browser submission; the receipt must verify against the current browser session and exact reviewed persistence payload before storage.
cookies.deletion: Cleared after successful confirmation, explicit cancellation, invalid confirmation, or expiry; privacy-choice transitions revoke it, and logout/session rotation makes any surviving copy unverifiable because the originating browser-session identity no longer matches.

nonCookieState: founder_browser_sessions: service-role-only server-side session state keyed by a SHA-256 hash of the opaque browser capability

continuity_fingerprint: deterministic server-state integrity evidence over the active session identity and lifetime; it is not a browser/device fingerprint, does not use network/device tracking entropy, and grants no action authority

portfolio proof cookie / continuity receipt: bounded audit metadata over an exact repository/target/base/head/scope/evidence fingerprint; browserCookie=false and actionAuthority=false; it is never emitted with Set-Cookie and becomes historical when its bound fingerprint moves
prohibited: client-readable founder auth tokens in the FCR browser-session cookie
self-contained access or refresh token payloads in founder session cookies
writing portfolio proof cookies or continuity receipts into browser cookie storage
treating continuity_fingerprint, a proof cookie, or a browser session cookie as Founder Final, merge, deployment, provider, database, publication, billing, or destructive-action authority
caching any response that writes, rotates, or clears the founder session
